O.outcome_detail: frequency of feature use across tool-development articles

cells.quote: We find that the most explored characteristics are textual features followed by visual features, learners’ activities, and interactive features. Tools that aid learning through videos frequently utilize text from transcripts, video frames, and images.
cells.note: The review reports textual features as more frequently explored than visual features in tool-development research; no learning-effect estimate applies.
